purpose: Check the app's flood model against floods documented in Ahammad et al. 2026 (J. Indian Soc. Remote Sens. 54:2983-2998). Read-only: no app code or model change.
method: For each point and date, run gee_fetcher._analyze_sentinel1 (the app's own Sentinel-1 path, 250 m radius around the point, incident date = pass date). Read flood_model.fractions_pct.

point_rule.flood_zone: ESA WorldCover cropland, JRC occurrence 0, slope < 2 deg, MERIT HAND <= 2 m, box 87.65-87.80 E, 22.55-22.72 N (central Ghatal / Daspur-I, named as repeatedly flooded in the paper), seed 101, >= 1 km apart, first 6.
point_rule.high_ground: Same, but HAND >= 10 m, box 87.45-87.60 E, 22.68-22.87 N (Chandrakona-II uplands), seed 202, first 4.
point_rule.note: Paper's named villages (Table 4) could not be geocoded reliably, so a terrain rule is used.

dry_date_rule: First Sentinel-1 IW pass over Ghatal (87.7218 E, 22.6654 N) on or after 1 September.

dates.source: paper Table 1 lists 18-09-2024; archive has no pass on 17-18 Sep, nearest is 19 Sep 12:12 UTC
paper p.8: gauges below danger level; maps show negligible flooding

decision_rule: A point-date counts as 'flood detected' when flood >= 20 % of its 250 m area.

pass_criteria.C1_detection: Flood dates in 2017, 2021, 2023, 2024 (paper Table 7: >= 66 km2 flooded): flood detected at >= 50 % of flood-zone point-dates.
pass_criteria.C2_dry_false_alarms: Dry-year dates: flood NOT detected at >= 90 % of all point-dates.
pass_criteria.C3_high_ground: Flood dates: flood NOT detected at >= 80 % of high-ground point-dates.
pass_criteria.reported_without_criterion: 2016 (paper: small event, 38-39 km2 of 962 km2); uncertain shares; errors / no-data counted and listed, never dropped.

fixed_in_advance: Thresholds, model files, points, dates and criteria above are not changed after results.
